primary_cta.subtext: Look around at your own pace, no enquiry needed
primary_cta.placement: Move the <!-- CTA: primary --> marker from its current spot (after the 'Check your insurance covers overseas travel' H3, before the shortlist) into 'From the ring to the wedding abroad', directly after 'Once the ring is chosen, the next question is usually where.' That is where the 'where' question peaks, after the reader has shortlisted styles. The paragraph's own /destinations link is removed so the CTA block is the only primary link (no duplicate).

secondary_cta.subtext: The fee is agreed in writing before any work begins
secondary_cta.placement: Inline in the paragraph straight after the primary CTA block (replaces the 'talk to Wedded Concierge about a wedding abroad' anchor). The existing sentence already carries the fee-in-writing line the panel asked for, so the paragraph links the Concierge only.

lead_magnet.name: Wedded Wonderland digital magazine
lead_magnet.placement: End of the closing 'Start the conversation' section, as a low-commitment option for readers not ready to talk (search_visitor, early planner_couple). The closing paragraph currently says 'tell us about it' with no link, a dead end for a dreaming reader.

payload.rationale: Brief sets journey_stage dreaming, service_link /destinations, with Wedded Concierge secondary, matching the services.md early-stage rule. Weighted enquiry likelihood is 1.7: nobody enquires from a ring styles article, so the destinations hub is the primary, low-pressure next step and the Concierge stays secondary. The marker currently sits before 'How to choose', which asks the reader to think about destinations before they have shortlisted a ring; moving it to the 'where' sentence puts the invitation at the moment the question is raised. The panel's must_fix (fee and payments worry, brochure wording) is already resolved in 08-final.md with brand-facts claims only (one Wedded Advisor, venue, travel, vendors and payments, fee agreed in writing before any work begins), so that line becomes the secondary subtext. Deposits, commission, named Advisor or phone line, real weddings and uhnw scale or security are deferred in brand-facts.md and are not stated. No prices. The magazine exists (link-map /magazine, type magazine, topic lead magnet) and services.md lists it as the early-stage magnet. Suggested future magnet, not placed: a printable 'ring style shortlist' or 'destination wedding starter' checklist (does not exist on the site). All three targets confirmed in content-system/seo/link-map.csv (last_seen 2026-10-20).
